title: 第15章 盲盒与菩萨求月票第16章 历史迷雾
content_zh:
盘算了一阵后，赵晨不再犹豫，直接选择了兑换“原主记忆”
由于这个“商品”
处于抵押状态，获取的条件也已经满足，所以无需再额外付出星币。
随着金光一闪，列表中的“原主记忆”
消失，正准备接收记忆的赵晨但却什么都没有感觉到，仿佛自己兑换了各“寂寞”
直到十几秒后，他才突然“明白”
过来：原主十几年的记忆太过庞大，径直接收可能会造成精神分裂，所以“星槎”
将记忆画面分批次安排到了睡梦中，每天睡着后都能获得一部分。
“还挺为我着想的……就是这种突然往我脑子里塞‘提示’的习惯可不太好！”
赵晨吐槽了一句，不过他已经和这“大日星槎”
绑定，也无可奈何。
叹息一声后，赵晨拉开“可出售列表”
随手将《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》和师傅的注解卖了出去，反正这只是在售卖“知识”
，对于现实里的秘籍并无影响。
两份“知识”
总共收获了410星币，但由于需要抵扣欠下的250，实际所得仅有160星币。
有了“钱”
，自然就有了购物的冲动，赵晨手指连点，翻到了“玉册”
的商品列表页，看向了那寥寥几个可以兑换的功法和物品。
“《睚眦咒诅密录》残篇……记载方虚子诅咒我所用法术的典籍啊，竟然要300？买不起，过！

“《计都星神法》真气卷，这似乎是一本和《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》同层次的基础功法啊……可惜要400，也买不起，过。
“一道‘摧魂夺魄诅咒术’低配版法术……80星币，虽然买得起，但这属于一次性技能，兑换出来就得立刻用掉……我现在又不用对敌，而且看方虚子那个凄惨的下场，我可不敢去用它阴人，风险太高了……过！
“邪道‘方虚子’残魂，130星币虽然拿的出，但我一不会炼魂的手段，二没有拘魂遣将的神通，买来也没用啊……过！
“下面是‘盲盒’……也就是‘方虚子人生记忆片段’，50一次，这倒可以考虑一下，万一抽到有价值的内容就赚大了……嗯，这个待定。
“再下面是……《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》？这不是我刚兑换给星槎的吗？这就立刻上架了？价格是……800？竟直接翻了一倍……真黑啊！”
赵晨虽然猜到自己兑换给星槎的东西想要再买回来恐怕会被加价，但也没想到能加这么狠。
似是察觉到了他心中所想，玉册自行切换到了这本秘籍的介绍页，只见上面写着：
“《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》精髓在于‘太初金玉引导法’这一用‘上古云篆’书写的根本心法，只有完美理解这段大道文字，才能得‘太初’真意，修成‘五仙中灵真气’。
“此功法为‘上古云篆’完美翻译版，翻译本身价值400星币，再加原本400星币，总计800星币。”
翻译……“大日星槎”
竟然还隐藏着“解文”
content_en:
After thinking about it for a while, Zhao Chen no longer hesitated and directly chose to redeem the "original owner's memory"
Because of this "commodity"
It is in a mortgage state and the conditions for acquisition have been met, so there is no need to pay additional star coins.
With a flash of golden light, the "memory of the original owner" in the list
Zhao Chen disappeared and was about to receive the memory, but he felt nothing, as if he had exchanged all kinds of "loneliness"
It wasn't until more than ten seconds later that he suddenly "understood"
Come here: The memory of the original owner for more than ten years is too huge, and directly accepting it may cause schizophrenia, so "Xingcha"
The memory scenes are arranged into the sleep in batches, and you can get some of them every day after falling asleep.
"It's quite considerate of me...but this habit of suddenly inserting 'hints' into my head is not a good one!"
Zhao Chen complained, but he was already with this "Da Ri Xing Cha"
There is nothing you can do about binding.
After sighing, Zhao Chen opened the "For Sale List"
I casually sold the "Secret Records of the Twelve Gates of Jinlou and Jade Chamber" and the master's annotations. Anyway, this was just selling "knowledge".
, has no effect on real-life cheats.
Two pieces of "knowledge"
A total of 410 star coins were harvested, but due to the need to offset the 250 owed, the actual income was only 160 star coins.
With "money"
, naturally had the urge to shop, Zhao Chen clicked his fingers and turned to the "Jade Book"
On the product list page, he looked at the few techniques and items that could be redeemed.
"The fragment of "The Secret Record of the Curse of Yajue"... the book that records the spells that Fang Xuzi used to curse me, costs 300? I can't afford it, let's pass!
"The "Jidu Star Divine Technique" Zhenqi volume seems to be a basic technique at the same level as "The Secret Records of the Twelve Gates of the Golden Tower and Jade Chamber"... It's a pity that it costs 400 and I can't afford it, so pass.
"A low-end version of the 'Soul-Destroying Curse' spell... It costs 80 star coins. Although it is affordable, it is a one-time skill and must be used immediately after redemption... I don't have to fight the enemy now, and seeing Fang Xuzi's miserable end, I don't dare to use it to trick people. The risk is too high... Pass!
"Although I can get 130 star coins for the remnant soul of the evil path 'Fang Xuzi', but since I don't know how to refine the soul, and secondly, I don't have the magical ability to restrain souls and dispatch generals, it's useless to buy it... pass!
"The following is the 'blind box'... which is also the 'Memory Fragment of Fang Xuzi's Life'. It's 50 per time. You can consider this. If you draw valuable content, you can make a lot of money... Well, this is to be determined.
"The next thing is..."The Secret Records of the Twelve Doors of the Golden Tower and the Jade Room"? Isn’t this what I just redeemed for Xingcha? Will it be put on the shelves immediately? The price is... 800? It actually doubled...it's so dark! "
Although Zhao Chen guessed that the price of the items he exchanged for Xingcha would be increased if he wanted to buy them back, he did not expect that the price would be increased so harshly.
As if aware of what he was thinking, the jade book automatically switched to the introduction page of this secret book, and it read:
"The essence of "The Secret Records of the Twelve Gates of the Golden Tower and the Jade Room" lies in the 'Taichu Golden Jade Guidance Method', which is the fundamental mental method written in the 'Ancient Cloud Seal Script'. Only by perfectly understanding this great text can we obtain the true meaning of 'Taichu' and cultivate the 'Five Immortals' Spirit True Qi'.
"This technique is a perfect translation of the 'Ancient Cloud Seal'. The translation itself is worth 400 star coins, plus the original 400 star coins, for a total of 800 star coins."
Translation..."大日星槎"
There is even a hidden "Jiewen"
